observations.title: 固定三反引号包围正文的旧机制在 review builder 的静态上下文
observations.classification: related only; no new finding or candidate
observations.evidenceLevel: Static source only. No new Markdown lexer/render/export/model/prompt-injection test.
observations.detail: Ordinary Markdown source or a diff context line can contain closing triple backticks; builder inserts the body unchanged between fixed triple backtick fences. Same mechanism as old R2-03; actual model interpretation and security impact unverified.

observations.title: UTF-16 slice 截断的旧机制在 review content 上限的静态上下文
observations.classification: related only; no new finding or candidate
observations.evidenceLevel: Static source only. No new Unicode truncate/encode/UI/model test.
observations.detail: Content slice(0,maxChars) may cut a surrogate pair at a positive/default boundary. Same mechanism as old DESKTOP-R12-01; no claim that prior Desktop source repair covers this builder.

note: Old fixed-fence and UTF-16 mechanisms in new static contexts; no new runtime/repeated finding count.
